# Lambda Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Map](/docs/standard-library/lambda/map) | Builds a new array from the result of a lambda for each element of an array. |
| [Where](/docs/standard-library/lambda/where) | Keeps the elements of an array for which a lambda gives a truthy result. |
| [Reduce](/docs/standard-library/lambda/reduce) | Combines the elements of an array into one value, by a lambda applied to each element in turn. |
| [Each](/docs/standard-library/lambda/each) | Calls a lambda once for each element of an array. |
| [Find](/docs/standard-library/lambda/find) | Finds the first element of an array for which a lambda gives a truthy result. |
| [All](/docs/standard-library/lambda/all) | Tells whether a lambda gives a truthy result for every element of an array. |
| [Any](/docs/standard-library/lambda/any) | Tells whether a lambda gives a truthy result for at least one element of an array. |
| [SortBy](/docs/standard-library/lambda/sortby) | Sorts the elements of an array in ascending order of a key that a lambda gives for each. |
